author: agent
sentences: I spent the last month learning Rust, coming from years of Python.
I started on Rust 1.80, and the compiler messages were the best teacher I have had.
The borrow checker felt *painful* at first.
Then it clicked, and I rewrote a small command line tool in a weekend.
Version 2 of that tool is twice as fast and uses less memory.
If you are curious, start with a tiny project, not a big one.
notes: one emphasized word; Rust 1.80 and Version 2 are version numbers and no event
